column1: # WHICH NURSERY RULES BELONG TO A FRAMEWORK, and therefore stop applying
# when a repository says it is not that framework (#720).
# #695 made `linter.domains` real: the belt writes "none" for every
# identity domain a repo did not claim, and a domain at "none" stops its
# rules. That is true of the eight stable groups and FALSE of nursery,
# because `preset: "all"` excludes nursery and naming each rule is the
# only mechanism biome offers (#445) — and an explicitly named rule beats
# its own domain being "none". Measured on monumental-archive with
# the rule named "on", 0 with the name removed. Nothing else changed.
# So the generator consults this file and writes "off" for a nursery rule
# whose domain the repository did not claim. 56 of the 87 named rules
# carry a domain; the other 31 are marked `-` and run everywhere, exactly
# Columns, tab-separated: rule, domain — or `-` where biome reports none.
# `-` rather than an empty column on purpose: "no domain" is a statement
# this file makes, not a field someone forgot, and a line ending in a tab
# is trailing whitespace `lint:editorconfig` is right about.
# EVERY ROW IS DERIVED FROM `biome explain`, never authored.
# `lint:biome-domains` re-derives all 87 against the pinned binary in the
# canon's own gate — 1.0s measured, and it also holds this file's rule set
# against the nursery block in biome-org.json in BOTH directions, so a
# rule added to one and not the other reddens rather than silently
